feature_name: Codex Worker Pool DEV token restore

sdd_gate.evidence_contract: Restore must be exact-command-bound, session-bootstrapped and executed through an exact temporary Owner Risk3 action that expires quickly and is removed after the attempt; the expired global DEV mode must not be required. Existing valid host auth is reused and never rotated merely because the API returns 401. When the canonical bind-mounted local file is missing/empty, create a CSPRNG token atomically only at the proven host path. Because atomic replacement of a file bind can leave the running container attached to an older inode, a 401 mismatch must compare host/container token contents only in memory without logging either value; if they differ, recreate only the canonical codex-worker-pool Compose service with force-recreate/no-deps/no-build and then require authenticated readback. If host and container already match but the API still rejects auth, fail closed as worker_pool_auth_process_mismatch. No secret/path value appears in logs/artifacts. Ordinary smoke must pass afterward. Compose label paths are reused only while they still exist; if their originating governed worktree has been removed, fallback is allowed only to the current version-controlled canonical compose filename after a minimal auth/port/state contract validation. Docker exec and compose recreate failures remain distinguishable through sanitized reason codes.
